test1_Lifshitz.note: Normal state has a 3rd-order (pi,pi) Dirac-cone Lifshitz transition at mu_N=4t (V_L~0.694t, N_cone(E)~|E-4t|/V_SO^2). In the SC state, min E_{k,s} >= 0.94t everywhere, so there is no Fermi surface (N_SC(E_F)=0) and mu_SC=4t (0.562t) is a smooth gapped crossover, NOT a physical QPT.

test2_hysteresis.protocol: ascending V_SO continuation vs stored descending sweep
test2_hysteresis.conclusion: differences at machine precision exclude branch coexistence (no first-order hysteresis loop)

test3_finite_size_scaling.interpretation: peak height/curvature growing with Nk signals a singular (critical) onset; saturation signals a smooth crossover

test4_pair_instability.interpretation: Delta_t=4.5: lambda>>1 everywhere -> normal state unstable to pairing at all V (pairing onset is a crossover). Delta_t=3.5: lambda grazes below 1 near V=[] (if it persists at Nk=401: normal state locally stable there while nonzero Delta_S self-consistently exists -> multistability, candidate first-order pairing region requiring a grand-potential comparison).

notes: N(E_F) shows a secondary van-Hove-like structure near V_SO/t ~ 1.2-1.3 (mu vs band-1 saddle/edge), flagged for separate study; the primary Lifshitz kink is at V_Lifshitz.
